ShortDescription.Value: Set pillar spacing for elevated roads, tracks and paths separately, from 40 m to 1000 m.

Publish.LongDescription:
Set the maximum distance between pillars on elevated roads, tracks and paths, each with its own setting. Built from scratch for game version 1.6, without Harmony patches.
## Features
* Separate pillar spacing for **roads** (including bridges built with roads and tram roads), **tracks** (train, tram, subway) and **paths** (pedestrian, bicycle). * Spacing from 40 m to 1000 m. Spacing above 200 m is supported: road segments are allowed to be longer automatically. * Settings apply immediately and are applied automatically every time a save is loaded. No need to toggle anything after restarting. * One-click restore to vanilla. * Interface in English and Simplified Chinese. "Auto" works with translation mods.
## Not affected
* Prefab bridges (cable-stayed, suspension, arch, grand bridge): their towers are placed proportionally along the bridge by the game, so there is no spacing to change. * Draw bridges, lift bridges, piers, quays and dams.
## Notes
* Only affects roads built after the change. Rebuild existing bridges to apply. * If a change does not seem to apply, reselect the road tool. * Do not use together with ConfigurableElevatedRoad or BridgePillarAdjuster: they change the same values. * Safe to remove: saves stay intact.
